values.note: Map classes: S up to 20 ft, M up to 25, L up to 30, X up to 35, U over 35; S sites won't fit a 23-ft rig.

facilities.source: https://apps.web.maine.gov/parksearch/ (park_id=26) (services list showers, RV dumping station), read 2026-11-02

note: Recommended by Grok as one of the best campgrounds in Maine.  Some campsites appear to be lakefront.  --AWH  Waterfront-audited 2026-06-18: downgraded to not waterfront - the Sebago shore is day-use beaches (Witch Cove, Naples Beach) and the 250 sites are set back in pine forest behind them; no campsite frontage, lake views pine-screened. Big sandy beaches for day use; 92 sites have E/W hookups. Pin moved onto the camping loops. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 250 sites, hookups (electric and water), showers, dump. Dropped the RV Life line from the note, --AWH text verbatim. Fees, season, min stay stand.
flags: WATERFRONT: --AWH says 'Some campsites appear to be lakefront'; stored 'not waterfront'. Not changed. The map draws west-end sites 201L, 203L, 204L, 205S, 206U, 207L and 208M along a thick road near the shore; imagery shows a ~400 m sandy shore from ~43.9151,-70.6005 to ~43.9160,-70.5965 with cut paths and pads behind ~43.9158-43.9163,-70.597, and OSM's road runs 25-50 m from the water there. East end, sites 3U-6U, 12L, 13X and 14X lie near Naples Beach on a dashed trail. The road stands between those sites and the sand, so on-water doesn't earn, and a filtered lakeview from the west-end sites is the live question. The official campsite photos that would settle it are the Google Earth KML on maine.gov, which refused and which I didn't work around. Distances are imagery/OSM estimates.
PHONE: entry has none. Campground in season (207) 693-6613 (Memorial Day-Labor Day); office (207) 693-6231.

BOOKING group holds only min_stay; reservable/platform/fcfs are empty. The public index shows online reservations 5/18-9/13/2026, 14 nights per reservation, all first-come from 9/14, but the group has manual provenance so I left it: apply the same pattern as the other Maine parks if wanted.
PIN fine: 43.9155,-70.5915 sits within the site span (OSM service ways -70.6007 to -70.5875 at 43.9155-43.9185), under canopy. The 92 hookup-site count in the note was not recounted against the map.

UNREAD: the state's site-search refuses out of season, so per-site lengths weren't read; maine.gov/dacf/parks pages answer 403 to plain HTTP and I didn't work around it (including the park guide and the Google Earth campsite KML), so fee and season text stays from the earlier read.
